nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory Weekly Update: SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and RSV are in the “High” category nationwide. The other respiratory viruses (Influenza B, HMPV, and EV-D68) we monitor remain in the “Low” wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/mcVSrzYSR1

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the “High” category with high concentrations and no significant trend up or down over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/mxEe1PxesA

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.3 variant in light blue (32.3%) and XEC variant in green (30.8%) make up approximately 63% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/DAuBH4eFkp

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the “High” category with high concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in the “Low” category nationally, but in the high category in the West. https://t.co/pS8zhdF2GO

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 19 states since the start of monitoring - AR, CA, CO, DE, FL, IA, ID, IL, KS, ME, MI, MN, NE, NV, NJ, SD, TN, TX, & UT. As of 2/12/24, CA, CO, IA, ID, MI, MN, NV, SD, TX & UT have also had infected cattle herds reported. https://t.co/15t4NQIEQ8

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations with no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. Levels are increasing in the Midwest. https://t.co/kDTD416Q9o

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ EV-D68: EV-D68 is in the “Low” category nationally and in all regions. Levels are very low in all regions except the West. https://t.co/em99evuyQv

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions remain in the “High” category. https://t.co/YtBGbtjcXV
